snippet.title: EA SPORTS FC 26 – Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase 7.31.2025
snippet.description:
Pre-order EA SPORTS FC 26 today on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/ea-sports-fc-26-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

The Club is Yours in EA SPORTS FC 26. Play your way with the overhauled gameplay experience powered by community feedback. Enjoy Manager Live Challenges that bring fresh storylines to the new season, and Archetypes inspired by the greats of the game.

The Ultimate Edition is available for early access on Sept 19, 2025 and Standard Edition is available on Sept 26, 2025 on Nintendo Switch 2.

#TheClubIsYours #FC26 #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
